summary: Shows json_query returning hash maps of name and port, and using starts_with and contains in queries, which require passing data through to_json | from_json first.
questions: How do I return multiple fields per item with json_query?
How do I filter by name prefix with json_query?
Why do starts_with and contains fail in my json_query?

answer_card.title: Projections and string functions in json_query
answer_card.answer_md:
Multiple fields:

```yaml
q: "domain.server[?cluster=='cluster1'].{name: name, port: port}"
```

String functions need `to_json | from_json` first:

```yaml
msg: "{{ domain_definition | to_json | from_json | community.general.json_query(q) }}"
vars:
  q: "domain.server[?starts_with(name,'server1')].port"   # or contains(name,'server1')
```
